variant: Alignmenter (window frame setting) and WeldFixer (bracket welding)
name: YKK AP MABOT window installation robots
summary: Pair of self-driving robots that set aluminium window frames into building openings (Alignmenter) and weld steel brackets around the set frames to fix them (WeldFixer), taking over from window installers on non-timber buildings. Developed by the Japanese window maker YKK AP, with site trials planned by spring 2025 and practical use targeted for FY2028.

germany.statusNote: Prototype for building sites in Japan; YKK AP aims for practical use on sites in fiscal 2028. No sale, rental or European route found.

specs.label: WeldFixer working height
specs.conditions: places and welds steel brackets on all four sides of the frame
specs.quote: 地上から高さ３・２メートルの範囲で、窓枠の四周に鉄製ブラケットを自動配置し溶接する

specs.label: Step it can cross
specs.quote: ２０ミリメートル程度の段差は乗り越える

specs.label: Power
specs.quote: コードレスのバッテリー駆動で自在に移動し

specs.label: Navigation
specs.value: moves to each set frame using map data made from the BIM model; avoids people and obstacles and stops on contact
specs.quote: 人や障害物を回避して接触時には自動停止する

specs.label: Frame positioning
specs.value: reads the black ink reference line marked at the opening and corrects for its own position error and opening inaccuracy
specs.conditions: Alignmenter; detachable end effector for different window types
specs.quote: アライメンターは開口部に書かれた黒色墨の基準線を認識し、窓枠の位置決めを高精度で実施する

specs.label: Crew and time
specs.conditions: remote operation of the robots compared with installers doing setting and welding
specs.quote: ロボットの遠隔操作により人員数と作業時間を半分程度に削減

notes: Two machines: the Alignmenter sets the frame with an arm-mounted, detachable end effector; the WeldFixer then welds the fixing brackets. Each has one arm as pictured; wheels assumed.
Welding under inert gas to suppress sparks (press).
Office-building windows are mostly semi-custom, so the maker says the sites where the robots can be used are limited for now.

sources.title: ロボットでビル窓施工、YKK APが実用化へ (Nikkan Kogyo Shimbun, 27 December 2024)
